name: data-grid
label: Data Grid
description: A composable TanStack data grid family with editing, virtualization, drag-and-drop, and Base UI-friendly controls.

files.content:
export { DATE_OPERATORS, DATE_OPERATOR_LABELS, matchesDateFilter } from "./date"
export { NUMERIC_OPERATORS, matchesNumberFilter } from "./number"
export { TEXT_OPERATORS, TEXT_OPERATOR_LABELS, matchesTextFilter } from "./text"
export { formatFilterLabel } from "./filter-label"
export { createExcelFilterFn } from "./filter-function"

import type { NumericOperator } from "@/types/data-grid-filter"
import { matchesNumberFilter } from "./matching/number-matching"

export const NUMERIC_OPERATORS: readonly NumericOperator[] = ["=", ">", "<", ">=", "<="]

export { matchesNumberFilter }

import type { TextOperator } from "@/types/data-grid-filter"
import { matchesTextFilter } from "./matching/text-matching"

export const TEXT_OPERATORS: readonly TextOperator[] = [
  "contains",
  "notContains",
  "equals",
  "notEquals",
  "startsWith",
  "endsWith",
  "blank",
  "notBlank",
]

export const TEXT_OPERATOR_LABELS: Record<TextOperator, string> = {
  contains: "Contains",
  notContains: "Does not contain",
  equals: "Equals",
  notEquals: "Does not equal",
  startsWith: "Starts with",
  endsWith: "Ends with",
  blank: "Is blank",
  notBlank: "Is not blank",
}

export { matchesTextFilter }

export { validateTextFilter } from "./text-validation"
export { validateNumberFilter } from "./number-validation"
export { validateDateFilter } from "./date-validation"
export type { FilterValidationResult } from "./validation-result"
